audit_item: 1.13 Settings Logic - RNS Operator Status & Target Year Reconciliation

discrepancy_analysis.issue: Settings UI showed target year 2026 while operator_status was 'non_operated' (which requires base + 5 = 2028). In addition, Regional operational profiles and Sonatrach corporate registry define Rhourde Nouss (RNS) as 100% operated by Sonatrach Exploration & Production.

Option_A (Recommended).rationale: Aligns with Sonatrach Regional Operational Profile ('100% Operated') and historical 2026 target.

Option_B.rationale: Keeps non-operated status but correctly sets 5-year compliance clock to 2028.
